DUALITY FOR CROSSED PRODUCTS OF VON NEUMANN 
ALGEBRAS BY LOCALLY COMPACT GROUPS 
BY YOSHIOMI NAKAGAMI 
Communicated June 30, 1975 
The duality for crossed products of von Neumann algebras by locally com-
pact abelian groups has been obtained by Takesaki [4]. We shall generalize this 
result to a locally compact (not necessarily abelian) group by using the Fourier 
algebra in place of the dual group.
